name: Parameters.irreducible_cyclotomic
summary: Map Φ_{N₁} along K ↪ M = ℚ(ζ_d); over M it is associated to the minimal polynomial of a primitive N₁-th root ζ, because φ(d)·φ(N₁) ≤ [M(ζ):ℚ] forces [M(ζ):M] ≥ φ(N₁).

steps.lean: lemma irreducible_cyclotomic : Irreducible (cyclotomic (P.N₁ s) P.K) := let M := cycloField P.d

steps.claim: Let ζ be a primitive N₁-th root of unity in the cyclotomic extension M(ζ) = CyclotomicField(N₁, M).
steps.lean: have hζ := zeta_spec (P.N₁ s) M (CyclotomicField (P.N₁ s) M)

steps.claim: A monic polynomial whose image under a ring homomorphism is irreducible is irreducible; take the ℚ-embedding K → M of `nonempty_algHom_of_isPrimitiveRoot` (√−d ∈ ℚ(ζ_d), d ≡ 3 mod 4); it remains that Φ_{N₁} is irreducible over M.
steps.lean:
(monic ..).irreducible_of_irreducible_map
    (QuadField.nonempty_algHom_of_isPrimitiveRoot _ (zeta_spec _ ℚ M)).1 _ (by simpa using ((
    associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.dvd _ _ (aeval_zeta ..)) (monic ..).ne_zero (by
    simpa [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ M, (hζ.powerBasis _).finrank, ↓Rat.finrank P.d, pos,
    natDegree_cyclotomic] using
      totient_mul_totient_le_finrank _ _ (coprime_N₁_d ..) hζ ((zeta_spec _ ℚ M).map_of_injective
    (algebraMap ..).injective))).irreducible (minpoly.irreducible (.of_finite ..))))

steps.claim: Over M, the minimal polynomial of ζ divides Φ_{N₁} (ζ is a root) and, by 3.1.1, has degree at least deg Φ_{N₁}; so Φ_{N₁} is associated to it.
steps.lean:
(QuadField.nonempty_algHom_of_isPrimitiveRoot _ (zeta_spec _ ℚ M)).1 _ (by simpa using ((
    associated_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.dvd _ _ (aeval_zeta ..)) (monic ..).ne_zero (by
    simpa [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ M, (hζ.powerBasis _).finrank, ↓Rat.finrank P.d, pos,
    natDegree_cyclotomic] using
      totient_mul_totient_le_finrank _ _ (coprime_N₁_d ..) hζ ((zeta_spec _ ℚ M).map_of_injective
    (algebraMap ..).injective))).irreducible (minpoly.irreducible (.of_finite ..))))

steps.claim: deg Φ_{N₁} = φ(N₁) ≤ [M(ζ):M]: since N₁ and d are coprime (`coprime_N₁_d`) and M(ζ) contains the primitive roots ζ and ζ_d, φ(d)·φ(N₁) ≤ [M(ζ):ℚ] = [M(ζ):M]·[M:ℚ] = [M(ζ):M]·φ(d) (`totient_mul_totient_le_finrank`).
steps.lean:
(by
    simpa [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ M, (hζ.powerBasis _).finrank, ↓Rat.finrank P.d, pos,
    natDegree_cyclotomic] using
      totient_mul_totient_le_finrank _ _ (coprime_N₁_d ..) hζ ((zeta_spec _ ℚ M).map_of_injective
    (algebraMap ..).injective)))

steps.claim: A polynomial associated to an irreducible minimal polynomial is irreducible.
